metadata.control_contents: Baseline plus generic-constraint property diagnostics and constraint depth-limit marking; no allocation refactoring.
metadata.method: 50 alternating measured pairs after 3 warmup pairs. CPU counters have 10 ms resolution. Every run must preserve stdout SHA-256 and exit status.
metadata.limitation: Substantial unrelated host load: one snapshot reported 0% idle CPU, load average 34.50, 62 GB physical memory used, and about 3.5 GB compressed memory. Wall-time results are inconclusive; no speedup claim is made.
